name: Galantamine
summary: Galantamine is best framed as a conservative research profile with mechanistic evidence and a focus on Cognition. Current workbook signals support mechanistic context around Neurotransmitter Modulation, not treatment claims.

contraindications: Cholinesterase-inhibitor cardiac effects can include bradycardia or atrioventricular heart block or other vagotonic slowing of heart rhythm
avoid with unstable angina or congestive heart failure or recent myocardial infarction or pre-existing conduction abnormalities
caution when combined with other drugs that lower heart rate
caution with asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or seizure disorders or peptic ulcer disease due to cholinergic effects
contraindicated with known hypersensitivity to galantamine.
evidence_grade_explanation: The recorded grade (strong evidence) and evidence tier (preliminary evidence) conflict, so the weaker signal is published pending review.
evidence_rationale: Strongest recorded design is a randomized controlled trial, drawn from 2 recorded studies, 2 in people.
